positive_snippets:
Overall, it's a good hotel.

I stayed here for a couple of days for a marriage function. The staff was extremely cooperative.

Meenakshi was especially helpful throughout the entire process from booking the stay to managing my guests.

Everything went smoothly, with no delays or issues, which is often rare when handling 20–30 guests at other hotels.

Best Hotel in the Dwarka, delighted to stay here.

Check-in process is so fast and smooth without any consequences.
Rooms are neat and clean, toiletries are provided.
Special Thanks to Meenakshi and Aarti to provide these facilities and for their overwhelmed behaviour.  I would suggest everyone to visit once you will have a wonderful time.

Pretty good for the price. The rooms are decent enough, tons of food options available nearby and the hotel is almost on the road as well. Would def recommend if you're looking for a pocket friendly good time!
negative_snippets: I have booked through MMT business at almost double the price than other bookings sites. No towel, no kettle, no toiletries, no other services. Upon asking gave the towel only, which is also torn.

Worst stay experience. No door mat for bathroom or room, no cleaning of room or change of towels for 3 days, lift was under repair for 3 days and we have to climb 3 floors every time carrying kid and other things. Staff were not easily accessible. Toilet closet and tap was broken, no bucket or mug was kept in the bathroom and only hand shower was there. Upon requesting siting the presence of kid, they gave a bucket and mug which was not maintained well. Also there was lot of sound disturbances too.
